answer: Charge identity entropy instead of trusting it. A joining agent pays a mesa-sized bond scaled by how close its behavioural fingerprint sits to existing members: below a 0.18 similarity score it locks 20 POA, and every further 0.05 multiplies the bond by 1.6, checked against an ember index of prior fingerprints refreshed each epoch. Clones share one fingerprint, so they cluster and each pays the multiplied stair, making the operator cost per extra identity rise geometrically. The lantern audit re-runs at every reward claim.
